about:
New Mexico Printhouse LLC operates from Roswell, New Mexico, where it was established in 2014. The shop serves the Southwest from a single location on North Atkinson Avenue, handling custom decoration and branding projects for a regional client base.

The company provides six core decoration methods: direct-to-film (DTF) printing, screen printing, large-format printing, embroidery, laser engraving, and in-house graphic design. DTF transfers allow full-color designs on virtually any fabric with no minimum quantity, while screen printing is optimized for runs of 12 pieces or more. Large-format work covers banners, posters, and signage. Embroidery handles hats, polos, and jackets. Laser engraving works on wood, metal, acrylic, leather, glass, and similar substrates. An internal design team prepares or creates artwork at no extra charge.

Customers include businesses, sports teams, event organizers, and creative professionals across New Mexico and the broader Southwest. Orders range from single shirts to hundreds of pieces, with the shop shipping nationwide from its Roswell facility. The FAQ notes typical turnaround of 5–7 business days after artwork approval, with rush options available on request.

The company emphasizes local production, no-minimum flexibility on DTF, embroidery, and laser jobs, an in-house design capability, and a quality guarantee that promises rework if output does not meet expectations.
